mcp.name: KitSolo
mcp.tagline: 你的 AI 文本与数据工具箱
mcp.taglineEn: Text and data tools for your AI agent
mcp.desc: 使用统一账号弹窗关联后，StudySolo Agent 可直接检索工具、处理 JSON、编码、哈希和时间戳；结果以卡片反馈并提供工作台入口。
mcp.descEn: Connect using your 1037Solo account in a popup. StudySolo Agent can search tools and process JSON, encoding, hashes and timestamps, with result cards and workspace links.
mcp.notes: 点击连接后，下一轮 Agent 对话可使用 KitSolo 工具。输入发送至 KitSolo 进行本次计算，不保存。可在 KitSolo 连接管理页撤销。其他学习服务由各自的原生连接器处理。
mcp.notesEn: Connect to enable KitSolo tools in the next Agent turn. Inputs are sent to KitSolo for transient processing and are not stored. Revoke access from KitSolo connection settings. Other learning services use their respective native connectors.
mcp.author: 1037Solo

mcp.name: Notion
mcp.tagline: 读取笔记与资料，经确认后写入工作空间
mcp.taglineEn: Connect Notion notes and references. Writes require confirmation.
mcp.desc: 连接你的 Notion 工作空间，读取笔记和参考资料。写入会先生成候选内容，经你确认后执行。
mcp.descEn: Connect Notion notes and references. Writes require confirmation.
mcp.author: 1037Solo

mcp.name: Todoist
mcp.tagline: 查询待办任务，经确认后安排学习计划
mcp.taglineEn: Read tasks and prepare confirmed study-plan changes.
mcp.desc: 连接 Todoist 读取任务与项目，整理学习计划。新增或修改任务需要先确认候选。
mcp.descEn: Read tasks and prepare confirmed study-plan changes.
mcp.author: 1037Solo

mcp.name: Google Drive / Calendar / Gmail / Contacts
mcp.tagline: 按需授权资料、日历、邮件和联系人
mcp.taglineEn: Authorize files, calendars, mail and contacts by capability. Writes require confirmation.
mcp.desc: 选择要授权的 Google 资料、日历、邮件和联系人功能。服务通过官方 API 接入助教；发送邮件或创建日程需要你确认。
mcp.descEn: Authorize files, calendars, mail and contacts by capability. Writes require confirmation.
mcp.author: 1037Solo

mcp.name: GitHub
mcp.tagline: 只读仓库、代码、Issue 与 PR 学习资料
mcp.taglineEn: Read repositories, code, issues and PRs for study
mcp.desc: GitHub 官方远程 MCP：检索仓库、代码、Issue 和 PR。本产品的学习连接默认只读，账号授权由学习服务连接管理完成。
mcp.descEn: Official GitHub remote MCP for repositories, code, issues and pull requests. Native learning connections are read-only and use account authorization.
mcp.author: GitHub
mcp.notes: 本产品可在学习服务连接管理中关联 GitHub。其他客户端需要支持远程 MCP 与对应授权；本项目的用户凭证不会复制到客户端配置。
mcp.notesEn: Connect GitHub in native learning connection settings. Other clients need remote MCP and authorization support; StudySolo user credentials are not exported.

mcp.name: Zotero
mcp.tagline: 只读连接个人文献库、集合与引用
mcp.taglineEn: Read references, collections and citations from your personal library.
mcp.desc: 以只读权限连接个人 Zotero 文献库，查询文献、集合和引用。
mcp.descEn: Read references, collections and citations from your personal library.
mcp.author: 1037Solo

mcp.name: PubMed
mcp.tagline: 搜索公开医学文献与摘要
mcp.taglineEn: Search public biomedical papers and abstracts. No third-party login required.
mcp.desc: 助教使用公开接口检索医学文献与摘要，无需第三方账号授权。
mcp.descEn: Search public biomedical papers and abstracts. No third-party login required.
mcp.author: 1037Solo

mcp.name: Crossref
mcp.tagline: 查询 DOI 和论文引用信息
mcp.taglineEn: Look up DOI metadata and citations. No third-party login required.
mcp.desc: 助教通过公开接口查询 DOI 元数据和引用信息，无需第三方账号授权。
mcp.descEn: Look up DOI metadata and citations. No third-party login required.
mcp.author: 1037Solo

mcp.name: Anki 导出
mcp.tagline: 将当前复习板的闪卡导出为 Anki 文件
mcp.taglineEn: Export completed flashcards to an Anki import file; no Anki application connection is performed.
mcp.desc: 把当前复习板中已完成的闪卡导出为 Anki 可导入文件，不远程控制 Anki 程序。
mcp.descEn: Export completed flashcards to an Anki import file; no Anki application connection is performed.
mcp.author: 1037Solo

skills.name: LaTeX 公式检查
skills.tagline: 核对笔记/回答里的 KaTeX 公式能否正确渲染
skills.taglineEn: Verify KaTeX formulas in notes and answers actually render
skills.desc: 让 Agent 在写公式前后自查：定界符配对、命令合法性、KaTeX 支持范围（本应用用 KaTeX 渲染，不支持 \ce、\pu 等需宏扩展的命令会提前提示替代写法）。
skills.descEn: Makes the agent self-check formulas before writing: delimiter pairing, command validity and KaTeX coverage (this app renders via KaTeX — unsupported macros like \ce/\pu get flagged with alternatives up front).
skills.author: StudySolo

skills.name: 考研真题解析模板
skills.tagline: 五段式拆真题：考点→题眼→步骤→易错→变式
skills.taglineEn: Five-part exam breakdown: topic → trigger → steps → traps → variants
skills.desc: 把一道真题按「考点定位 / 题眼拆解 / 规范解题 / 易错警示 / 变式练习」五段展开，输出一致格式的解析，适合刷题后沉淀错题本。
skills.descEn: Expands one real exam question into a fixed five-part analysis — topic mapping, stem reading, model solution, common traps, variant drills — ideal for building a mistake notebook.
skills.author: StudySolo

skills.name: 笔记整理助手
skills.tagline: 把零散记录收成层级大纲 + 术语表 + 自检问题
skills.taglineEn: Turn scattered notes into an outline, glossary and self-quiz
skills.desc: 让 Agent 把课堂速记/划线摘录整理成：层级大纲（≤3 级）、术语速查表、每条主干的「一句话总结」、末尾附 3-5 个自检问题，可直接粘回笔记。
skills.descEn: Reshapes raw class notes and highlights into: a ≤3-level outline, a quick glossary, one-line takeaways per branch, and 3–5 self-check questions — ready to paste back into your notes.
skills.author: StudySolo

skills.name: Notes to Handbook
skills.tagline: 将学习笔记整理为 HTML 手册与 PDF
skills.taglineEn: Restructure notes into an HTML handbook and PDF
skills.desc: 安装完整脚本、模板、引用与经过验收的云端渲染依赖。仅独立 Agent 模式可运行命令并下载产物。
skills.descEn: Install the full scripts, templates and references with a verified cloud rendering runtime. Command execution belongs to main Agent mode.
skills.author: 1037Solo · My-Skills

skills.name: GB 标准文档装订
skills.tagline: 按文稿类型选择规范，生成和检查 DOCX/PDF
skills.taglineEn: Select appropriate standards and prepare DOCX/PDF
skills.desc: 完整技能包、引用与结构检查脚本。云端支持 LibreOffice 转换和 PDF 检查；要求 Word/WPS 时仍须由对应应用完成最终验收，不承诺自动国标认证。
skills.descEn: A complete package with references and structural checks. Cloud conversion uses LibreOffice; Word/WPS acceptance still requires that application. No automatic standards certification claim.
skills.author: 1037Solo · My-Skills
